title: pchic_gat: Contact Topology Alone — A Promoter-Centred Sequence-Structure Fusion Network for Multi-Task Prediction of Gene Regulatory State from Promoter Capture Hi-C Loop Calls
description: Promoter-anchored PCHi-C / Hi-C subgraphs + promoter sequence + histone marks fused into two embedding spaces, evaluated across four supervised heads with 5-fold gene-grouped cross-validation. Companion code for the paper of the same name.
